result.instructions: Tools for TotemClock, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who clocked in late at our Milan site this week?"; "Show me Maria's calculated day for 2026-09-11, with overtime and anomalies."; "Record a CLOCK_OUT for employee 7f1c… at 17:30 with the same externalId on retry.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TotemClock data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run totemclock_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run totemclock_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run totemclock_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. totemclock_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: totemclock_get_organization
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Return the company that owns the API key: name, slug, and timezone. Good first call to confirm which company is connected. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/organization.

tools.name: totemclock_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List active employees with code, name, job title, department, hire and termination dates, and attendance mode (SCHEDULED, SINGLE_DAILY, EXEMPT, ACTUAL). Use the id in the other tools. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/employees.

tools.name: totemclock_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List active company sites with address, punch policy (NONE, GEO, QR, GEO_OR_QR, GEO_AND_QR), and geofence radius in meters. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/sites.

tools.name: totemclock_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: List active work schedules and which employees each one is assigned to. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/schedules.

tools.name: totemclock_list_punches
tools.title: List punches
tools.description: List raw clock punches (CLOCK_IN, CLOCK_OUT, BREAK_START, BREAK_END) in a date-time range, optionally for one employee. Range is required. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/punches.

employeeId.description: Only punches for this employee id.

tools.name: totemclock_create_punch
tools.title: Record a punch
tools.description: Record one clock punch for an employee (CLOCK_IN, CLOCK_OUT, BREAK_START, BREAK_END) at occurredAt. externalId makes the call safe to retry: the same externalId and payload return the existing punch. Needs the punches:write scope. TotemClock API: POST /api/v1/punches.

externalId.description: Your own unique id for this punch, unique inside the company. Reuse it on retries.

occurredAt.description: When the punch happened, with offset, e.g. 2026-09-09T08:00:00+02:00.

siteId.description: Site id (from totemclock_list_sites), if the punch has a site.

tools.name: totemclock_get_employee_day
tools.title: Get an employee day
tools.description: Return one employee's punches and calculated result for one day: first in, last out, worked, target, overtime, late and early-leave minutes, and anomalies. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/days/{date}.

tools.name: totemclock_list_timecards
tools.title: List daily timecards
tools.description: Return the calculated daily timecard rows for all employees on one day (default: today in the company timezone). TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/timecards.

date.description: The day, yyyy-mm-dd. Omit for the company's current day.

tools.name: totemclock_get_monthly_timecard
tools.title: Get a monthly timecard
tools.description: Return one employee's calculated monthly timecard: each day, the causes behind the results, and monthly totals. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/monthly-timecards.

tools.name: totemclock_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get a monthly timesheet
tools.description: Return one employee's monthly timesheet: the hours and activities assigned to customers, projects and work, with the total minutes. TotemClock API: GET /api/v1/timesheets.

prompts.description: What you can do with TotemClock here, with example requests to try.
